description: This file provides utility functions for command-line argument parsing and environment variable reading, primarily aimed at handling flags, options, and environment variables in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads and parses a number from an environment variable, returning null if not present or invalid.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and if so, consumes the next argument as its value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and if so, consumes the next argument as a string value in a list.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and parses the next argument as an integer with bounds checking.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if the current argument matches a flag and parses the next argument as a float with bounds checking.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for string options.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for string list options.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for integer options with optional bounds.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for float options with optional bounds.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for boolean toggle options.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse an array of command-line arguments based on provided specifications and options.
